name: Aggregated Bidirectional Scattering Distribution Function (ABSDF)
aliases: Scene Appearance Aggregation for LoD Rendering
Scene Appearance Aggregation for LoD Rendering (Ours)
definition: A method for efficient scene appearance aggregation for Level-of-Detail rendering, based on a novel formulation for far-field scene aggregation with the definition of ABSDF (Aggregated Bidirectional Scattering Distribution Function), which captures the aggregated appearance of all surfaces within a volume.
